facts.fact: The African Union Commission's status list records Chad as having signed the African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection (Malabo Convention) on 14 June 2015.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection

facts.fact: The same list, dated 2 February 2026, shows no date of ratification or accession and no date of deposit for Chad, so as at that date Chad had signed but not ratified.
facts.system: African Union Convention on Cyber Security and Personal Data Protection
